imports.title: Bring your church records into ChuFlow
imports.description: Upload an existing spreadsheet, match its columns, review the results, then import valid records into one church.
imports.safeHint: Importing creates records only. It does not record visits, send welcome messages or grant staff access. Existing records are not overwritten.
imports.fileLabel: Choose an Excel, CSV or TSV file
imports.fileLimit: Up to 8 MB and 10,000 records per import. Use .xlsx, .csv or .tsv.
imports.googleInstructions: In Google Sheets choose File → Download → Microsoft Excel (.xlsx), or Comma-separated values (.csv), then upload that file here. You do not need to publish your sheet or make it public.
imports.mappingHint: Map First name and Last name, or Full name. Full name splits at the first space: review compound names carefully. Phone is required for guests. Group names must already exist before member import. Import children through the Children workspace so guardian and pickup links are preserved.
imports.previewFive: Preview the first five mapped rows
imports.chooseData: Choose a church and a sheet containing 1–10,000 data rows.
imports.oneColumn: Use each spreadsheet column only once.
imports.nameMapping: Map first name and last name, or map a full-name column.
imports.phoneMapping: Map a phone column for guest records.
imports.readError: Could not read this spreadsheet. Please try again.
imports.reviewHint: Review the destination church, mapped values and flagged rows. Only valid rows will be created. Duplicate and invalid rows are skipped; download the results to correct them.
imports.confirmChurch: I have reviewed these records and the destination church.
imports.resumeHint: Keep this page open while importing. If interrupted, reopen this import from history and resume. Already imported rows will not be created twice.
imports.retention: Import details and row results are retained for 30 days. Imported church records remain available.
imports.name: Name
imports.incomplete: This upload was interrupted before any records were created. Start a new import with the same file.
